title: DT Midstream Reports Record 2025 Results; Raises Dividend and Increases Project Backlog by 50%
summary: Full year 2025 Adjusted EBITDA of $1.138 billion, a 17% increase from 2024 Increased dividend by 7% Announced final investment decision on two pipeline projects DETROIT, Feb. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - DT Midstream, Inc. (NYSE: DTM) today announced fourth quarter 2025 reported net income of $111 million, or $1.08 per diluted share. For the fourth quarter of 2025, Operating Earnings were also $111 million, or $1.08 per diluted share. Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was $293 million. Full year 2025 reported net income was $441 million, or $4.30 per diluted share. For full year 2025, Operating Earnings were also $441 million, or $4.30 per diluted share. Adjusted EBITDA for the year was $1.138 billion.
